n06f9fdb166.headline: 2025 Budget LIVE: Key points as Chancellor to announce changes to UK finances
n06f9fdb166.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves is announcing changes to UK finances in the 2025 Budget. Coverage includes key points on what the budget means for the UK.
n06f9fdb166.why: The UK Budget sets tax and spending policy, which influences government borrowing, gilt yields and the outlook for sterling.

na41b56a558.headline: Australia will enforce a social media ban for children under 16 despite a court challenge
na41b56a558.summary: The Australian government said the ban on social media for children under 16 will proceed next month as scheduled, despite a rights group's court challenge.
na41b56a558.why: The law is a world-first restriction on youth access to social platforms, with implications for platform user growth and advertising revenue.

n7bd68536b3.headline: Giving thanks for bad economic news
n7bd68536b3.summary: Weaker-than-expected US economic data has increased bets for a Federal Reserve interest rate cut, according to Reuters Open Interest. The commentary covers US and global markets.
n7bd68536b3.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and expectations for rate cuts influence Treasury yields, the dollar and equity valuations worldwide.
n7bd68536b3.why_moved: Softer-than-expected US data raised expectations of Fed rate cuts. Lower expected policy rates typically pull Treasury yields down and affect the dollar and equities.

n086324d1ec.headline: Demetra posts €13.7m nine-month profit as stock-exchange gains and higher interest income lift results
n086324d1ec.summary: Demetra Holdings reported a nine-month 2025 profit of €13.7 million, versus €42.4 million a year earlier. Gains from the Cyprus Stock Exchange and higher interest and rental income supported results.
n086324d1ec.why: Demetra is a Cyprus-listed holding company; its results reflect exposure to the local stock exchange and property income.

n45e635138b.headline: Australia will enforce a social media ban for children under 16 despite a court challenge
n45e635138b.summary: The Australian government says children under 16 will be banned from social media next month as scheduled. The ban proceeds despite a legal challenge.
n45e635138b.why: The ban affects major social media platforms, whose advertising revenue depends on young users in some markets.

n5ec9ac1d5c.headline: G-20 summit triumph as Trump’s absence boosts South Africa’s moment: Katzenellenbogen
n5ec9ac1d5c.summary: Ramaphosa was hailed for defying Trump at Africa's first G20 summit, which focused on Africa, multilateralism and global declarations. Trump's absence was seen as boosting South Africa's moment.
n5ec9ac1d5c.why: The G20 brings together the world's major economies to coordinate on trade, finance and development policy.

n03b32b6e6c.headline: What is the two-child benefit cap and why has it been so controversial?
n03b32b6e6c.summary: The DWP two-child benefit cap stops parents claiming universal credit or tax credit for a third or subsequent child. The policy has been controversial.
n03b32b6e6c.why: Welfare rules affect public spending and household incomes, which feed into UK fiscal policy and consumer demand.

n66cc71e6ee.headline: Crude Prices Gain on Doubts About a Russian-Ukrainian Peace Deal
n66cc71e6ee.summary: WTI crude and RBOB gasoline futures rose slightly. Dollar weakness and doubts about a deal to end the Russia-Ukraine war supported prices.
n66cc71e6ee.why: WTI is a benchmark US crude oil contract traded on the New York Mercantile Exchange, and oil prices feed directly into fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.

impacts.name: WTI crude oil
impacts.why: The input reports WTI crude rising on weaker dollar and doubts about a Russia-Ukraine peace deal.

n66cc71e6ee.why_moved: Oil rose slightly as dollar weakness boosted dollar-priced crude and doubts grew about a deal to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

n356160f748.headline: Nigeria: NNPC Releases 2024 Audited Financial Statement, Declares N5.4 Trillion Profit, N45.1tn Revenue
n356160f748.summary: NNPC Ltd released its audited financial statement for the year ended 2024. It reported a profit after tax of N5.4 trillion on revenue of N45.1 trillion.
n356160f748.why: NNPC is Nigeria's state-owned oil company, and its finances bear on government revenue and the country's oil sector.

nc39382e66b.headline: Warner Bros Discovery seeks improved bids by December 1, sources say | Company Business News
nc39382e66b.summary: Warner Bros Discovery has asked potential buyers to submit improved offers by December 1, two sources familiar with the matter said. The request signals an ongoing sale process.
nc39382e66b.why: Warner Bros Discovery is a major US media and entertainment company, and its sale process could reshape the media sector's competitive landscape.
nc39382e66b.why_moved: A request for improved bids signals an active sale process, which bears on the company's valuation and the terms any buyer may offer.

n1cbee97893.headline: Mixed results for Africa in Belém as Brazil
n1cbee97893.summary: African negotiators secured some of their key demands on adaptation finance at the Belém talks in Brazil. Observers caution that the details of the agreement still matter.
n1cbee97893.why: Climate finance decisions shape the capital flows and investment risk for developing economies, especially those exposed to climate shocks. Adaptation funding helps governments plan infrastructure and resilience spending.

neb21a14455.headline: Few investors copy Warren Buffett’s investment strategy ‘because no one wants to get rich slow,’ the retiring Berkshire Hathaway CEO says
neb21a14455.summary: Warren Buffett, 95, said few investors copy his strategy because no one wants to get rich slowly. He will retire as Berkshire Hathaway chief executive at the end of 2025.
neb21a14455.why: Berkshire Hathaway is a large conglomerate and investment holding company whose leadership transition closely watched by investors. Buffett has led the company for about 60 years.

n4db4f5d494.headline: Apple to surpass Samsung in global shipments for 1st time in 14 years
n4db4f5d494.summary: Counterpoint Research said Apple's smartphone shipments performed strongly in 2025, particularly in Q3. Apple is expected to reach a 19.4% global share in 2025, making it the top smartphone company.
n4db4f5d494.why: Apple and Samsung are the two largest smartphone makers, and shipment share shapes revenue and supplier demand across the handset industry. Market share changes signal shifts in competitive position.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Counterpoint expects Apple's strong shipments to lift its global smartphone share to the top position.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n46f40ceeff.headline: Rs 4 lakh crore added! Sensex surges over 750 pts, Nifty above 26,100 as metal, PSU bank stocks shine
n46f40ceeff.summary: Indian benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty rose sharply on November 26, reversing a three-day decline. Metal and PSU bank stocks led the rebound, which followed positive global cues from Wall Street and Asia.
n46f40ceeff.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's main equity benchmarks, tracking large listed companies across the economy. Metals and state-owned banks are sensitive to commodity prices and domestic credit conditions.
n46f40ceeff.why_moved: Metal and PSU bank stocks led the gains, reversing a three-day downtrend. Encouraging signals from Wall Street and Asian markets supported the rebound.

n64a33d3a25.headline: Markets Today: RBNZ Cut Rates, Gold Hits Two-Week Highs, FTSE 100 Trades Above 200-day MA Ahead of UK Budget
n64a33d3a25.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand cut interest rates, with the Australian and New Zealand dollars jumping. Gold reached two-week highs while European stocks rallied on peace hopes, ahead of the UK Budget.
n64a33d3a25.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, which drives the New Zealand dollar and local borrowing costs. Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often reacts to geopolitical and rate expectations.
n64a33d3a25.why_moved: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand cut rates, which lifted the AUD and NZD. Peace hopes supported European equities and gold rose to two-week highs.

n023db31340.headline: South Africa’s G20 Presidency: Diplomatic Victory, but a Weak Final Declaration
n023db31340.summary: Efforts by US President Donald Trump to derail the G20 summit in Johannesburg failed, but the final declaration was weak, according to Inter Press Service.
n023db31340.why: The G20 groups the world's major economies, and its declarations shape coordination on trade, finance and global economic policy.

n8908f4e667.headline: KLK posts higher FY25 net profit of RM817.27mil
n8908f4e667.summary: Kuala Lumpur Kepong's net profit for the year ended September 30, 2025 rose to RM817.27 million from RM590.96 million, driven by higher profit in the plantation and property segments.
n8908f4e667.why: Kuala Lumpur Kepong is a major Malaysian palm oil plantation and property group, so its results signal conditions in palm oil markets.

n5eaffcf36a.headline: Live: Reeves asks ‘everyone to make contribution’ in Budget tax threshold freeze
n5eaffcf36a.summary: The Office for Budget Responsibility apologised after releasing its economic and fiscal outlook early, ahead of the Budget. The Budget includes a freeze on tax thresholds.
n5eaffcf36a.why: Budget tax and borrowing decisions shape UK fiscal policy, which influences government bond yields and sterling.
n5eaffcf36a.why_moved: The Budget's threshold freeze and the early release of the fiscal outlook bring UK fiscal policy into focus for investors.

n7589244aa8.headline: Race to vaccinate 7.2 million cattle as foot-and-mouth crisis bites
n7589244aa8.summary: South Africa is rolling out a nationwide vaccination of its 7.2 million cattle to contain foot-and-mouth disease. The campaign aims to stop further value being lost from the livestock sector.
n7589244aa8.why: Animal disease outbreaks can restrict livestock trade and reduce the value of cattle and beef production.

nbe0b73b4a5.headline: First Atlantic Bank begins process to become publicly listed company
nbe0b73b4a5.summary: First Atlantic Bank has formally begun the process to transition into a publicly listed company. The bank describes the move as a major step toward stronger governance and long-term growth.
nbe0b73b4a5.why: A stock listing gives a bank access to public capital markets and adds disclosure and governance requirements, which can affect how investors value it.

n1b76f83a71.headline: Inflation continues to rise, dashing hopes of interest rate cuts
n1b76f83a71.summary: Inflation in Australia continued to rise, dashing hopes of interest rate cuts. Housing was the main driver of inflation.
n1b76f83a71.why: Inflation data shapes central bank rate decisions, which influence bond yields, the currency and borrowing costs.

n60364c5518.headline: Health makes wealth, says Equirus, as healthcare fundraising crosses pre-Covid high of Rs 62,432 crore
n60364c5518.summary: Equirus says India's healthcare and life sciences fundraising has surpassed its Covid-era peak, with inflows above Rs 62,432 crore. FY26 fundraising has already exceeded Rs 72,440 crore.
n60364c5518.why: Capital raised through equity offerings and M&A indicates investor appetite for India's healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

n1051916b00.headline: M&S considering opening new food store in Abergele as part of expansion
n1051916b00.summary: Marks & Spencer is considering opening a new food store in Abergele, Wales. The move is part of the retailer's expansion plans.
n1051916b00.why: Marks & Spencer is a major UK retailer whose food business drives a large share of its sales, so store openings signal growth plans.

n8a7f224507.headline: Funds, analysts push back on Summerset cap raise speculation
n8a7f224507.summary: A large Summerset shareholder has downplayed speculation that the company needs to raise capital to pay down debt. An investment analyst called the suggestion off the mark.
n8a7f224507.why: Summerset Group is a New Zealand retirement village operator, and debt levels and equity raises affect its funding costs and shareholder value.

n6533c83a38.headline: National minimum wage to go up to £12.71 as full time wage increases to £26k a year
n6533c83a38.summary: The national minimum wage is set to rise by 4.1% to £12.71 an hour for low-paid workers. The 18 to 20-year-old rate would also increase, with the full-time wage reaching £26,000 a year.
n6533c83a38.why: The UK National Minimum Wage sets the legal pay floor for employers, so changes raise labour costs for businesses, particularly in retail and hospitality.

na9515c0ce1.headline: Farmland prices stall as rural property enters consolidation phase
na9515c0ce1.summary: Farmland prices have stalled as rural property enters a consolidation phase. Cautious farmers are holding land, and sales have hit record lows.
na9515c0ce1.why: Farmland values reflect agricultural incomes, interest rates and credit conditions, and they matter for rural banks and agribusiness investors.

n583b9e12e8.headline: MESA AIR :  Republic Airways and Mesa Air Group Complete Merger
n583b9e12e8.summary: Republic Airways and Mesa Air Group have completed their merger, creating a publicly traded regional airline. The combined company is headquartered in Phoenix and connects communities across America.
n583b9e12e8.why: Mesa Air Group is a publicly traded US regional airline that operates flights under contracts with major carriers, so consolidation affects its competitive position.

n5281751f6f.headline: F&P Healthcare surpasses $1b 1H revenue for the first time
n5281751f6f.summary: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare reported first-half revenue above $1 billion for the first time, a 14% increase. The medical device maker is listed on both the NZX and ASX.
n5281751f6f.why: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare is a New Zealand medical device maker known for respiratory and surgical products, and is a major company on the NZX.

nd27a4631a3.headline: Brookfield, GIC Bid $2.60 Billion to Acquire National Storage REIT
nd27a4631a3.summary: National Storage REIT said it is the target of a A$2.60 billion takeover bid from Brookfield and Singapore's GIC. The article describes it as part of overseas investors seeking to buy Australian assets.
nd27a4631a3.why: National Storage REIT owns self-storage property in Australia, and Brookfield and GIC are large global infrastructure and sovereign investors.

nd3149305ac.headline: New Jersey Shoppers Adapt To Soaring Grocery Costs This Holiday Season
nd3149305ac.summary: Grocery bills are rising in New Jersey, and shoppers are using meal planning and local purchases to manage costs during the holiday season. The article does not provide price data.
nd3149305ac.why: Grocery price inflation is a key component of consumer price indexes and affects household spending power and retailers' margins.

nfd05c0ea86.headline: Reeves takes centre stage
nfd05c0ea86.summary: UK Finance Minister Rachel Reeves is set to unveil Britain's budget later today, a decision investors in European and global markets are watching closely.
nfd05c0ea86.why: The UK budget sets tax and spending plans that shape the government's borrowing needs, which feed into gilt yields and sterling.
nfd05c0ea86.why_moved: The budget is a major fiscal event, and its tax and spending measures shape expectations for UK borrowing and gilt yields.

n1751f4d0e3.headline: Australian growth firms, but RBA tipped to hold at 3.6%
n1751f4d0e3.summary: Australia's economy is described as more stable, but stubborn inflation is keeping rate cuts at bay. The RBA is tipped to hold the cash rate at 3.6%.
n1751f4d0e3.why: The RBA cash rate at 3.6% sets the baseline for Australian lending rates and asset valuations.

n3ee241b011.headline: Inflation surges as energy rebates run out of gas
n3ee241b011.summary: Australian headline inflation rose as lower energy rebates and higher housing costs than a year earlier pushed the rate up.
n3ee241b011.why: Inflation data shapes Reserve Bank of Australia interest rate decisions, which affect bond yields and the Australian dollar.

n0563b3f45f.headline: Thailand must adopt new laws to meet soaring AI and data centre demand, business leaders say
n0563b3f45f.summary: Thai business leaders urged the country to adopt data sovereignty laws to support growing AI and data centre demand while managing energy challenges.
n0563b3f45f.why: Data centre growth depends on regulation, power supply and digital infrastructure policy, affecting technology and energy investment.

na6119d6254.headline: Fresh business blend at Starbucks: Global CEO meets Chandra as Tata pauses investment pending lower-cost model
na6119d6254.summary: Tata Consumer is pushing for a more affordable Starbucks India model with smaller stores and lighter equipment. Fresh investment hinges on the leaner format, as the global CEO met Chandra.
na6119d6254.why: Starbucks operates in India through a joint venture with Tata Consumer, so changes to its store model affect expansion and unit economics for both partners.

nd436f7180c.headline: Bithumb to halt Tether-powered order book sharing service following regulatory pressure
nd436f7180c.summary: South Korean exchange Bithumb will close its Tether Market order book sharing service, launched on September 22, following regulatory pressure. The financial regulator had recently conducted an on-site investigation.
nd436f7180c.why: Bithumb is one of South Korea's largest crypto exchanges, and regulatory actions against such platforms affect trading volumes and stablecoin liquidity. Tether is the largest stablecoin by market value.

n0fc7cc3c6d.headline: Apple projected to beat Samsung in smartphone shipments for first time since 2011
n0fc7cc3c6d.summary: Apple iPhone shipments are expected to rise 10% in 2025, allowing it to reclaim smartphone leadership from Samsung. Strong reception of the iPhone 17 series is cited as the driver.
n0fc7cc3c6d.why: Apple is the maker of the iPhone, its largest revenue source, so shipment trends directly shape its earnings. Samsung is its main rival in smartphones.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Projected 10% rise in iPhone shipments would boost Apple's smartphone volumes.

n3f0f3802f0.headline: PETRONAS Dagangan records 3Q earnings fall on weak price trend
n3f0f3802f0.summary: PETRONAS Dagangan Bhd reported lower third-quarter earnings on weak price trends. The company is cautiously optimistic for the rest of 2025 and is focusing on adapting to market volatility.
n3f0f3802f0.why: PETRONAS Dagangan is Malaysia's largest fuel retailer, so its earnings track domestic fuel margins and softer oil prices.

n64482108d4.headline: Taiwan puts $40 billion toward buying US weapons and building a defense dome
n64482108d4.summary: Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te announced a special $40 billion budget for arms purchases. The package includes an air defence system with high-level detection and interception capabilities.
n64482108d4.why: Taiwan's defence spending shapes demand for weapons from suppliers, including US defence contractors. Cross-strait tensions affect regional risk for markets and trade.

n75e8144c6a.headline: Shambolic Budget to spark wealth exodus, warns deVere CEO
n75e8144c6a.summary: deVere Group's Nigel Green said the leaked UK Budget would drive an exodus of wealth from Britain, citing an extraordinary tax squeeze on high earners in mistakenly published OBR documents.
n75e8144c6a.why: deVere Group is a global financial advisory firm, and UK tax changes for high earners affect wealth management and investor flows.

nabad42147f.headline: Carney pins hopes on domestic market with new steel, lumber tariff supports
nabad42147f.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney wants Canada's lumber and steel sectors to find more opportunities at home, as US tariffs and shifting global trade limit their access abroad.
nabad42147f.why: Lumber and steel are major Canadian exports, so US tariffs directly affect producer margins and trade flows.

n1d51a68529.headline: Global Crypto Markets Largely Stagnant as MON Token Surges After Upbit Listing
n1d51a68529.summary: The crypto market is relatively calm with most altcoins trading quietly, while MON, newly listed on South Korea's Upbit exchange, surged dramatically. Bitcoin is near $86,600 and Ethereum near $2,900.
n1d51a68529.why: Upbit is one of South Korea's largest crypto exchanges, and new listings there often drive sharp short-term price moves in small tokens.

nd7b6a65626.headline: Microsoft partners with Powertrust to develop 270MW of solar projects in Mexico, Brazil
nd7b6a65626.summary: Microsoft has announced a collaboration with Vancouver-based Powertrust to develop 270 megawatts of distributed solar projects. The projects span Mexico and Brazil over the next four years.
nd7b6a65626.why: Microsoft is a major buyer of renewable power to supply its data centers, so long-term solar offtake deals support clean energy development.

nbe535bb364.headline: Shopify lays off staff to keep team
nbe535bb364.summary: Shopify Inc. said it has laid off some staff to help streamline the e-commerce software company. The company did not give further details in the summary.
nbe535bb364.why: Shopify is a Canadian e-commerce platform whose cost decisions and growth trajectory matter to investors in software stocks.

nc8525110f7.headline: Grayscale DOGE ETF Debut Volume Comes in Below Expectations
nc8525110f7.summary: Grayscale's Dogecoin ETF, the first US-based spot fund for the memecoin, saw lower-than-expected trading volume on its first day. Bitwise is set to launch its own Dogecoin ETF.
nc8525110f7.why: Spot crypto ETFs let investors gain exposure to a cryptocurrency through regulated brokerage accounts. Trading volume is a gauge of investor demand for a new fund.

n78f95c2585.headline: Williams Lake pellet plant announces plans to cease operations
n78f95c2585.summary: The Williams Lake pellet plant plans to cease operations, according to the report. Drax cites curtailments at local mills and the loss of a bid as reasons.
n78f95c2585.why: Drax is a UK-listed power and biomass company that supplies wood pellets, and mill curtailments and bid losses affect pellet producers' revenues.

ncb523c26b5.headline: Energy minister to brief B.C. Liberal MPs on expected Alberta pipeline deal
ncb523c26b5.summary: Energy Minister Tim Hodgson is set to brief B.C. Liberal MPs on the government's expected energy deal with Alberta. The deal is linked to a pipeline.
ncb523c26b5.why: Pipeline approvals determine how Alberta's oil sands crude reaches export markets, which affects producers and Canadian energy prices.
